k.q: Trace this ascending bubble-sort pass on three numbers.
k.code:
array values = [6,1,3]
for i=0 to 1
    if values[i] > values[i+1] then
        temp = values[i]
        values[i] = values[i+1]
        values[i+1] = temp
    endif
next i
print(values[0])
print(values[1])
print(values[2])
